==Biography==

== Trivia ==
*Known for having the highest CS rating in League of Legends history, with a score of 1456 creep kills, breaking [[Zven]] and [[Bang]]'s record of 946 and and 972 respectively. In general, he is known for always having high CS per minute statistics.
*His playstyle is generally considered to be that of a farming late-game hyper carry.  
* While playing for [[Jin Air Green Wings]], he was given the nickname ''Walking Nexus'' due to his strong performances, as he had such a big influence on the outcome of every match. 
*Has flash on the D key.<ref>[https://youtu.be/3BGNPWujnB0?t=143 🔥Let's go V9🔥 | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.2 <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
*Considered as a highly rated player of {{ci|Ezreal}}.
*If he could only pick one champion to play for the rest of his life, he would pick {{ci|Ezreal}}, considering Ezreal to be fun and stylish.<ref>[https://youtu.be/mCONcic-jz8?t=392 T1 LoL AMA | T1 CAMERA] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*Notorious in his team for being the one who shamelessly and speedily steals away both enemy and ally jungle camps.<ref>[https://youtu.be/mCONcic-jz8?t=170 T1 LoL AMA | T1 CAMERA] ''youtube.com''</ref> <ref>[https://youtu.be/3BGNPWujnB0?t=65 🔥Let's go V9🔥 | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.2 <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
*Is usually quite happy, loud, and energetic while streaming. His weird noises and moaning can sometimes be heard in other T1 members' streams<ref>[https://youtu.be/nyZW1DHGsk4?t=361 Faker Finds a Bug?]</ref> and has been remarked by teammates to be somewhat annoying. 
** His most well-known noises are "AWOOOOOO" and "OH~ YEAH BABY~".<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j9fi3lf6oqo&t=20 Best of T1 2020 Stream Highlight 🔥T1 Noise LP 40000🔥 <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FrxwKioqpB8&t=241 Teddy's Neeko is just as good as Faker's <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki> <nowiki>[</nowiki>T1 Stream Highlight<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mCONcic-jz8&t=272 T1 LoL AMA | T1 CAMERA] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*His catchphrases are "''Let's get it~''" and "''So sweet!''".
*Teddy says he would like to be remembered as "a good and funny gamer".<ref>[https://youtu.be/I5fpzGIeLmc Teddy's 1000 Kills in LCK | T1 2020] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*He dyed his hair blonde partly because he wanted to look like Ezreal.<ref>[https://youtu.be/I5fpzGIeLmc?t=119 Teddy's 1000 Kills in LCK | T1 2020] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*His favorite restaurant is Seogawon.<ref>[https://youtu.be/I5fpzGIeLmc Teddy's 1000 Kills in LCK | T1 2020] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*Teddy chose the name "Teddy" because he loves his stuffed animals and still sleeps with a teddy bear every night.<ref>[https://youtu.be/mCONcic-jz8?t=102 T1 LoL AMA | T1 CAMERA] ''youtube.com''</ref><ref>[https://youtu.be/n0hF6LEqoYk Teddy talks cutesy nicknames for his SKT teammates and the origin of his name] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*Prefers dogs over cats.<ref>[https://youtu.be/Ev6KPZvucQs SKT Teddy interview(2) "Cat vs dogs?"] ''youtube.com''</ref>
*Is left-handed
*Reached 1,000 kills in the LCK on February 26, 2020
**The 10th player to reach 1,000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], and [[Deft]].
**His 1,000th kill was on [[Griffin (Korean Team)|Griffin]]'s support [[Irove]] in the [[LCK 2020 Spring|LCK 2020 Spring Season]] with {{ci|Miss Fortune}}.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on June 17th, 2021.
** The 8th player to reach 1500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], and [[Ruler]].
* Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on July 23rd, 2023.
** The 4th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], and [[Ruler]].
** His 2000th kill was on [[DRX]]'s Bot Laner [[Paduck]] in the [[LCK/2023 Season/Summer Season|LCK 2023 Summer Season]] with {{ci|Kai'sa}}
* Reached 2500 kills in the LCK on August 31st, 2025.
** The 7th player to reach 2500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Aiming]], [[Ruler]], and [[Chovy]].
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on July 06, 2022, becoming the 6th player to do so, after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[Ruler]], [[Deft]], and [[Bdd]].
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on March 09, 2024, becoming the 6th player to do so, after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Peanut]], and [[Kiin]].
* Reached 700 games in the LCK on August 31, 2025, becoming the 7th player to do so, after Faker, Deft, Bdd, Peanut, Kiin, and [[Chovy]].
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on March 06, 2024, becoming the 16th player to do so.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on August 29, 2025.
** Was the 22nd player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK.
=== Awards ===
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2020)
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2021)
